title: LLM Agents, Low‑Bit Tricks, and System Updates
intro: This week the AI crowd wrestled with making LLM agents more reliable while engineers squeezed performance out of tiny bits and tiny chips. Meanwhile, the Linux kernel kept churning out patches and security fixes.

themes.headline: LLM agents get smarter, not bigger
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** Researchers focused on boosting agent reasoning without extra training. Turn‑level best‑of‑N sampling lifted accuracy 5–10%, speculative decoding tamed noise over 30 steps, and cached‑trace embeddings enabled efficient evaluation. Together they show a push toward smarter, lighter‑weight agents.

items.title: On Turn-Level Best-of-N Sampling for Scaling LLM Agents
Adversarial Speculative Reasoning Improves Long Horizon Agents
Task-Efficient Agent Evaluation Using Cached Traces

themes.headline: Low‑bit inference and memory tricks
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** Memory‑hierarchy‑aware frameworks like StrataFlux proved you can keep 2‑4‑bit weights fast while streaming higher‑precision data to preserve accuracy. Meanwhile Library of Layers reordered transformer blocks at runtime, and HARP showed training‑free dual‑profile communication for recommendation, highlighting a trend of architectural hacks over brute force scaling.

items.title: Library of Layers (LoL): Adaptively Ordering Transformer Layers at Runtime
HARP: Training-Free Dual-Profile Agentic Communication for LLM-Based Recommendation

themes.headline: Embedded & Linux ecosystem buzz
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** The Linux kernel saw a massive 7.4‑rc1 prepatch with 18,591 changesets from 2,678 developers, plus security updates across major distros. On the hardware side, ESP32 ran full Linux, a $15 FPGA board turned retro, and RISC‑V initiatives gained traction, underscoring a vibrant low‑level development scene.

items.title: Cheap FPGA Board Becomes Retro-Style Computer

themes.headline: Benchmarks and real‑world AI tasks
themes.body: **Lead‑in:** New benchmarks put LLM agents to the test on scientific and clinical problems—from Earth system model parameterizations to nasopharyngeal carcinoma care pathways—revealing both promise and gaps in accuracy and coverage.

items.title: Can LLM Agents Improve Imperfect Earth System Model Parameterizations?
NPCBench: A Clinical Apprenticeship Benchmark for Multimodal Care-Pathway Reasoning in Nasopharyngeal Carcinoma
